name: Bedrock uniBTC vault native mint without price conversion
summary: The uniBTC Vault's payable mint() treats msg.value as "native BTC" and mints uniBTC at _amount / EXCHANGE_RATE_BASE (1e10), i.e. one 8-decimal uniBTC per whole 18-decimal native coin, with no ETH/BTC price conversion. That path is only sound on BTC-gas chains; on Ethereum it minted BTC-denominated uniBTC one-for-one against ETH. The implementation activated at block 20826624 also replaced the native-mint guard require(address(this).balance <= caps[NATIVE_BTC]) with require(ISupplyFeeder(supplyFeeder).totalSupply(NATIVE_BTC) <= caps[NATIVE_BTC]); with caps[NATIVE_BTC] = 0 and the supply feeder reporting 0 for NATIVE_BTC, the check that had previously blocked every native mint on Ethereum passed, opening the path.
notes: Fourth and last pre-exploit Upgraded event on the TransparentUpgradeableProxy, emitted as log 338 of a Gnosis Safe execTransaction at block 20826624, selecting implementation 0x702696b2aa47fd1d4feaaf03ce273009dc47d901 in topic1. The EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc reads 0x702696b2aa47fd1d4feaaf03ce273009dc47d901 at block 20836583 and 0xc0c9e78bfc3996e8b68d872b29340816495d7e89 at block 20826623, so this event is the change that put the exploited code in service.

Single-transaction extraction. Inside the anchor transaction the attacker contract 0x1e1d02d663228e5d47f1de64030b39632a3b787d flash-borrowed 30.8 WETH from Balancer, unwrapped it, called Vault.mint{value: 30.8 ether}() and received 30.8 uniBTC (3,080,000,000 units, 8 decimals), sold 28.81420431 uniBTC into the Uniswap v3 uniBTC/WBTC 0.05% pool 0x3a32f5040bc4d8417e78e236eb2c48c90e003fda for 27.83925883 WBTC (worth about USD 1,810,471 at the incident timestamp), routed that WBTC through the WBTC/WETH pool 0x4585fe77225b41b697c938b018e2ac67ac5a20c0 for 680.404054576756594919 WETH, repaid the 30.8 WETH flash loan and deposited the remaining 649.604054576756594919 ETH into Aave v3 for 0xee800b1b63893ca1e1b0fa8fefdc10fac9b980f7, which withdrew it 43 blocks later. The measured loss is that 649.604054576756594919 ETH of realised extraction; the 30.8 ETH the attacker paid into the vault stayed with Bedrock and is not added back, and the 1.98579569 uniBTC left unsold in the attacker contract is not counted. Between blocks 20836664 and 20837340 roughly two dozen copycat addresses executed the same native mint for about 6.8 ETH in total; they are not attributed to this attacker and are excluded from the number, which is why contemporaneous reporting of about USD 2 million exceeds the USD 1.71 million measured here. Nothing was recovered: Bedrock's deployer 0x899c284a89e113056a72dc9ade5b60e80dd3c94f sent an onchain whitehat offer to both attacker addresses on 2024-09-27 and got no response, and between 2024-10-01 blocks 20871292 and 20871405 the beneficiary address moved 650.1 ETH into Tornado Cash. Fuzzland disclosed in 2025 that a former employee was the attacker and said it reimbursed affected parties off-chain; that is a third-party reimbursement, not a return of the stolen assets, and it is not netted out.
